scripts.electron:assistant: npm run electron:build && concurrently -k -s first "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5174 && node scripts/run-with-env.mjs CDP_PORT=9222 -- electron ./dist/electron/main.js --no-sandbox --start-page=assistant --auto-connect"

scripts.start:scene:debug: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs APP_UI_MODE=scene APP_SCENE_DEBUG=1 -- node scripts/ghost-agent-wrapper.mjs
scripts.ghost:build:all: npm run ghost:build && npm run ghost:electron:build
scripts.ghost:dev: npm run ghost:build:all && node scripts/run-with-env.mjs CDP_PORT=9222 -- electron ./dist/ghost-agent/electron/main.js --no-sandbox
scripts.ghost:handoff: npm run ghost:build:all && npm run electron:build && node scripts/ghost-agent-wrapper.mjs
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && npm run clean:logs
scripts.lint: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 -- eslint --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint "src/**/*.{js,ts}" "electron/**/*.{ts,cjs}" "ghost-agent/**/*.{ts,cjs}" "rooms/**/*.{js,ts}" && npm run mcp:lint && npm run scripts:lint
scripts.lint:strict: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 -- eslint --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint "src/**/*.{js,ts}" "electron/**/*.{ts,cjs}" "ghost-agent/**/*.{ts,cjs}" "rooms/**/*.{js,ts}" --max-warnings 0 && npm run mcp:lint:strict && npm run scripts:lint:strict
scripts.lint:fix: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 -- eslint --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint "src/**/*.{js,ts}" "electron/**/*.{ts,cjs}" "ghost-agent/**/*.{ts,cjs}" "rooms/**/*.{js,ts}" --fix && npm run mcp:lint:fix && npm run scripts:lint:fix
scripts.check: npm run lint:strict && npm run check-types && npm run rooms:test:core
scripts.check:all: npm run format:check && npm run lint:strict && npm run check-types && npm run test:all && npm run design:audit && npm run design:audit:rooms && npm run deps:check && npm run knip:strict && npm run rooms:build && npm run build:all
scripts.check:all:fix: npm run format && npm run lint:strict && npm run check-types && npm run test:all && npm run design:audit && npm run design:audit:rooms && npm run deps:check && npm run knip:strict && npm run rooms:build && npm run build:all
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p src/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p electron/tsconfig.electron.json && tsc --noEmit -p mcp-server/tsconfig.mcp.json && tsc --noEmit -p ghost-agent/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p ghost-agent/tsconfig.electron.json && tsc --noEmit -p rooms/tsconfig.rooms.json && npm run scripts:typecheck
scripts.update: npm run update:deps && npm run android:deps:update
